lines.text: The Kingdom of Glimmerdale. A land of heroes, magic, and remarkably thorough paperwork.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Welcome, hero! I'm Pip, your assigned Adventure Compliance Officer. Please initial here, here, and... here.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: I just wanted to fight slimes.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: And you legally may! Congratulations. Your slime license is valid in this meadow only.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Slimes need licenses now?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: No, YOU need the license. The slimes have a union. It's complicated. Look, here one comes!

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Excellent form! I've rated your first battle 'Exceeds Expectations'.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: It was one slime.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: One slime TODAY. Tomorrow? Possibly two slimes. Growth mindset, hero.

lines.speaker: Clipboard Goblin
lines.text: HALT. Do you have a Meadow Traversal Permit, Form MT-7?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: I have a sword?

lines.speaker: Clipboard Goblin
lines.text: A sword is not a form. I'm noting 'hostile and formless' in your file.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Oh no. He has a clipboard, hero. This just became SERIOUS.
A slime blocks the path. It is wearing a tie. The tie is load-bearing.

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: Hi, hi, welcome — Dave, Slime Supervisor. Real quick: I'm seeing a LOT of defeated slimes in your quarterly numbers.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: They attacked me.

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: Sure, sure. But have you considered... not? Anyway, I'm going to need you to fight me now. It's a whole process thing.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Careful! Middle managers hit harder when cornered by their own metrics!

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: Noted... noted... I'll flag this... in the system...

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Is he okay?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: He's fine. Slimes reform in 3-5 business days. He'll be back at his desk by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: Tell Gerald... the projections... were never real...
Moonrise over the meadow. In the distance: howling, and the unmistakable sound of a strike vote passing.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Bad news. The wolves have unionized. Worse news: their demands are actually quite reasonable.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Then why are they attacking us?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: We crossed the picket line. It's the meadow, hero. The ENTIRE meadow is the picket line.

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: So. Management sends a hero.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Nobody sent me. I'm just trying to cross the meadow.

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: That's what management WOULD say. Article 12: all meadow-crossers must either honor the strike or fight the rep. I AM the rep.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: His teeth have dental coverage, hero. Their teeth have TEETH.

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: You fight... like someone with excellent benefits.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: I don't even have a contract.

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: WHAT. Unacceptable. Here — take a union card. When you reach Gerald, ask him about YOUR quarterly numbers. Watch him squirm.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Did... did the miniboss just recruit us?
The heart of the meadow. A corner office with no walls, because it is a meadow. Three ties flutter in the wind.

lines.speaker: Gerald
lines.text: Ah. The disruption. Please, sit. I've reviewed your file: eleven slimes, one supervisor, and a union representative. That's a lot of turnover.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Your slimes attacked ME.

lines.speaker: Gerald
lines.text: They were meeting their engagement quotas. Which brings me to you. Your numbers are, frankly, incredible. I'd like to offer you a position.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Gerald
lines.text: Then, per policy, I must escalate. Gerald is now entering the meeting. GERALD IS NOW ENTERING THE MEETING.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: HERO. HIS COUNTDOWN. HE'S SCHEDULING A SLAM.

lines.speaker: Gerald
lines.text: This... this will reflect... very poorly... on the quarter...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: You did it! The meadow is free! All middle management has been... um... 'right-sized'!

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Where does that path lead?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Darkwood! Lovely this time of year. You'll need a hiking permit, a camping permit, and — oh dear — a permit permit.
The heroes walk on. Behind them, a small slime picks up a fallen tie, and slowly, ominously, begins to knot it.
